title: Light test
description: data of: lighttest.py SESSION --on HH:MM:SS --off HH:MM:SS --json. What a light round the house did to the sky the telescope saw, from the run's own frame records. Reads only.

on.description: When the light went on, local time.

frames_on.description: Kept frames wholly while the light was on.

frames_off.description: Kept frames wholly while it was off.

measures.description: background (sky level), stars, flux (star brightness), fwhm (star width): each with its median on and off, the change in percent, and the change in multiples of the off frames' own scatter.
